title: Parking Lot Farm Plot Waitlist Dilemma
setting: This vibrant urban farm occupies a repurposed asphalt parking lot, with raised wooden beds filled with leafy greens, herbs, and native wildflowers. A weathered wooden sign posted by the tool shed displays the long waitlist for individual growing plots, drawing daily questions from curious community members.

characters.name: Mara
characters.tendencies: Mara manages the official plot waitlist, resolving small disputes between prospective farm holders.

characters.name: Javi
characters.tendencies: Javi fields community inquiries and shares farm updates via in-person chats and phone calls.

characters.name: Lila
characters.tendencies: Lila tends the farm’s raised beds and teaches beginner farming skills to new plot holders.
